server_failure.message: string indices must be integers, not 'str'

root_cause: load_source_rows(capture) returns one list of selected-state dictionaries.
round_plan incorrectly unpacked that two-element list into handoff, source_rows.
Iterating the resulting second dictionary yielded string keys, causing the observed TypeError.
The same file also used row['selected'] although the frozen source adapter exposes row['handoff_state'].
The same file treated fingerprint dictionaries as attribute objects and passed a keyword-only exact_gamefile parameter positionally.
deployment.resolve_gamefiles likewise assumed an attribute fingerprint although the live source adapter returns a mapping.
fix_scope: Read handoff from its immutable handoff artifact.
Consume load_source_rows(capture) as the list it actually returns.
Use the existing handoff_state key and mapping fingerprint fields.
Make gamefile resolution accept the already-existing mapping form without changing scientific identities.
